test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 25 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A alone can do a piece of work in 6 days and B alone in 8 days. A and B undertook to do it for ₹3,200. With the help of C, they completed the work in 3 days. How much is to be paid to C?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Efficiency** is inversely proportional to **Time** taken when work is constant.

Total work (LCM of 6, 8, 3) = 24 units.

**A** efficiency = 4, **B** efficiency = 3, **A+B+C** efficiency = 8.

**C** efficiency = 8 − (4 + 3) = 1 unit.

Share of **C** = (1 ÷ 8) × ₹3200 = ₹400.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **A** = 6 days

Time taken by **B** = 8 days

Time taken by **A**, **B**, and **C** together = 3 days

Total **Contract Value** = ₹3200

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 **A**
 6
 24
 4
 
 

 **B**
 8

 **A + B + C**
 3
 8
 
 

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = Efficiency of (**A+B+C**) − Efficiency of (**A+B**)

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = 8 − (4 + 3) = 1 unit/day

⇒ Total efficiency = 8 units/day

⇒ Share of **C** = (Efficiency of **C** ÷ Total Efficiency) × Total Amount

⇒ Share of **C** = (1 ÷ 8) × 3200

⇒ Share of **C** = ₹400

**∴ The correct answer is ₹400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages Principle

Wages are distributed in the ratio of **Work Done**. If all persons work for the same duration, wages are distributed in the ratio of their **Efficiencies**.

Efficiency Formula

Efficiency = **Total Work** ÷ **Time Taken**. Total work is usually assumed as the **LCM** of time taken by individuals.

Combined Work

The reciprocal of time taken by a group is the sum of the reciprocals of time taken by individuals: 1/Tₜₒₜₐₗ = 1/TA + 1/TB + 1/TC.
